description: DSH sidebar notebook: notes with title and body, image attachments, clipboard copy, @ references, one reusable editor dialog, (0.2.0) capture from the conversation — selected text or a whole answer — and (0.2.1) a body box that sizes itself to its content. 0.2.2 drops the native confirm prompts (in-panel dialogs instead) and localizes every string to the shell language. 0.2.3 fixes the "open the notebook for new sessions" switch, which never opened the sidebar.
